failure.symptom: The browser input endpoint returned HTTP 200, but held actions produced no observed action change.
failure.server_contract: Only revisions strictly greater than the process-global input_revision are accepted.
failure.root_cause: The nanosecond verifier revision was about 1000 times larger than browser microsecond revisions and permanently outranked subsequent browser inputs in the same process.

prevention: Use one declared revision unit or a session-local sequence number.
Return whether an input update was accepted and the current server revision.
Do not let an external verifier permanently dominate a shared browser session.
Assert observed press and release action changes instead of accepting HTTP 200 as sufficient.
